topics.label: Introduction and Overview of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing, learning outcomes, and background framework for understanding the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Growth Signal Autonomy and Evading Growth Suppression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic mutations deregulate signaling pathways like Wnt, RTK/Ras, and TGF-beta to drive cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer cells arrest normal lineage differentiation across hematopoietic malignancies and intestinal carcinomas.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how cancer cells bypass programmed cell death through mutations affecting p53, Bax, and BCL2.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Cellular Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms of telomere maintenance and how cells bypass senescence barriers to achieve unlimited division.

topics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming and Oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how cancer cells rewire metabolic pathways toward aerobic glycolysis and how metabolic alterations feed back into epigenetic regulation.

topics.label: Induction of Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the requirement, timing, and regulatory balance of new blood vessel formation to sustain tumor growth.

topics.label: Invasion and Metastatic Dissemination
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the mechanical, physiological, and genomic factors that govern how cancer cells migrate, survive in circulation, and colonize distant sites.

topics.label: Lecture Wrap-up and Concluding Remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing, summarizing the integration of hallmarks and closing the lecture.
